entries.reason: the release's table asks its delegate for a delete confirmation and for nothing else, and it is the one that sends the message
entries.effect: the message is never sent: a swipe on a row shows the release's own delete button when the delegate allows deleting, and the application's actions are never shown, whatever the delegate answers
entries.source: UIKit of iOS 8.4 and the host's own UIKit

entries.reason: the release's own +[UIFont fontWithDescriptor:size:] takes a CTFontDescriptorRef and crashes on any other object, and the port does not replace system methods, so an application that hands a descriptor to it would crash
entries.effect: the class is not there: NSClassFromString answers nil, and an application that guards its use falls back to the fonts it names

entries.reason: the release has a method of this name that takes a CTFontDescriptorRef, and the port does not replace system methods
entries.effect: an application that passes a UIFontDescriptor, the class of iOS 7, crashes in the release's method on iOS 6.0; the class is not carried, so a program that only guards for it never gets there
entries.source: UIFoundation of iOS 6.0 armv7 and the emulator
